title: Services Not Further Described
description: You are on the house's books at forty a quarter. Down here, the books have a page with your name on it, and the page has an instruction.

the_instruction.title: The first instruction
the_instruction.objective: Minna Crale has your first instruction under the house's retainer. Read it, and tell her what you mean to do about it.
the_instruction.journal: Minna Crale found my name without looking, which tells me how often she has looked at it. There is an instruction for me. It came down on the same boat I did.

serving.title: The valley is quiet
serving.journal: The instruction was to attend the meeting and, if asked, say that the valley is quiet. That is the service. It is true, and they are paying me forty a quarter to say it in a warm room. I said I would. Minna Crale paid the second quarter in advance, which nobody asked her to do.

clause.title: A clause
clause.journal: I asked for a clause about ending it. Minna Crale put her pen down, which I think she does about once a year, and said nobody had ever asked. Then she wrote one: either party, a quarter's notice, in writing, to Number Nine. It is the first ending the house's articles have ever had, and I am the one who has it.

returned.title: Returned
returned.journal: I put forty gold on her table and said the articles were void. Minna Crale counted it, wrote me a receipt, and filed the receipt with the articles, so that the house now has a record of me taking its money and a record of me giving it back, and both of them are true. Mr Corse will be told. She says he will not be surprised.
